brief.goal: Set up Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui component library, add React Router with a narrow left sidebar navigation (icons + labels), implement dark/light mode theming, and migrate existing inline-styled components to shadcn-based components.
constraints: Electron app using file:// protocol — must use HashRouter
Currently zero CSS framework, zero routing, zero component library — all inline styles
Must preserve existing functionality (Dashboard, EmailList, TaskList, Settings, Onboarding)
shadcn CLI v4.19.0 installed but never initialized
nonGoals: No new feature pages (Notes, Conversations are separate issues #54, #55)
No new business logic — UI foundation only
successCriteria: Tailwind CSS + PostCSS configured and processing classes in dev and build
Left sidebar renders with 5-6 navigation items using Lucide icons + labels (narrow, ~60px collapsed, ~200px expanded)
Dark mode / light mode toggle persisted via localStorage
Existing Dashboard, EmailList, TaskList, Settings components still function correctly
shadcn/ui components installed and used for buttons, inputs, cards, dialogs, dropdowns
No inline style={{...}} in new/modified components — Tailwind classes instead

steps.prompt: Write a detailed feature specification for the UI foundation setup.

Implement the UI foundation: install Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, react-router-dom, lucide-react. Configure Tailwind with dark mode. Set up React Router with HashRouter. Create sidebar. Add dark/light mode toggle. Migrate components to Tailwind+shadcn.
Review the implementation against the specification and success criteria.

specify.output: Comprehensive feature specification covering Tailwind v4, shadcn/ui init, HashRouter, sidebar, dark/light mode, and component migration.

implement.output: Implemented Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui (11 components), React Router with HashRouter, collapsible sidebar with Lucide icons, dark/light mode toggle with CSS variables, and migrated Dashboard, Settings, EmailList, TaskList from inline styles to Tailwind. Typecheck and build pass.

converge.output: All 6 success criteria verified: Tailwind configured, sidebar renders (60px/200px), dark/light mode persisted, existing components function, shadcn components used (11), inline styles only for dynamic values. Build passes. No non-goals violations.
